note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: their elemental resistances fall. Used by the AI on packs and rare enemies.

def.name: Brittle Doom
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose elemental resistance.

note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: they act more slowly.

def.name: Leaden Limbs
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they are slowed in everything they do.

note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: they deal less damage.

def.name: Feeble Grip
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they deal less damage.

note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: they take more physical damage.

def.name: Open Wounds
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they take more physical damage.
